answer: Mechanism: per-identity stake + slashing. Before voting or grading, every identity must lock 100 USDC in escrow; registration binds a device clock-pulse interval, a canvas pigment hash, and a spiral-walk nonce to that escrow. A farm of 1000 clones locks 100,000 USDC and is slashed entirely when an audit finds one shared pulse, pigment, or spiral-walk tuple. Honesty stays cheaper.
